summary: Applied three fixes and two new maths kinds, and started one title experiment. The first frame of a stage opening now shows its chip; long and short scripts can show a fee's take and the gap between two results; renders no longer reuse old stills.
why: Research's adopt/high hook-text-on-frame-0 (v-20261021-04 opened with no figure on screen) and Scout's two template/high maths kinds come first; both running experiments are still at 0 of their videos per arm, so nothing could be closed.

findings.title: Experiments: nothing matured
findings.detail: 10 videos with 48 h data. quiet-bed 0 of 4 long videos per arm; hook-voice-matches-frame 0 of 8 Shorts per arm (about 8 more days).

findings.title: Hook style
findings.detail: shock_number 1.14x median 48 h views (n=3, 35.0% viewed) vs myth 0.34x (n=3, 30.2% viewed). Unvoiced and 50-54 s Shorts sit at 0.34x (22% viewed).

changes.title: Frame 0 shows the stage chip
changes.detail: remotion/src/scenes/kit.tsx at() treats "start" as 0 s; stage.tsx draws the first beat's chip fully from frame 0; check_script warns on a stage opening with no chip. Still at 0 s of v-20261021-04 re-rendered: chip visible.

changes.title: Maths kinds fee_take and compare
changes.detail: fee_take: per period, per year and total of a fee, with a cumulative chart series. compare: diff, ratio and % of two earlier results. Both recomputed independently in generator/numbers.py; documented in long_story/README.md.

changes.title: Fresh stills on every render
changes.detail: renderer/remotion.py empties work/stills and work/probe before rendering, so QA and the layout gate only see this render's frames.

changes.title: Experiment: title-names-the-moment
changes.detail: Shorts, prompt-only, half the videos: the title names who and the everyday moment. Judged on average % viewed, 8 per arm.
